summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature in the repository, but nothing was run, so tests/test_grid_dataset.py is unverified. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coords) pairs with coords computed from padding offsets; set_rnd skips dunder attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset rebuilt around an injected patch_iter, worker split with np.ceil, per-patch transform, with_coordinates toggle; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc after GridPatchDataset), and tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, plus test_missing_len). Test images were assumed to be np.arange(16).reshape(1,4,4) because that makes the pinned values consistent. Risk: the single-process checks use rtol 1e-5 against 4-decimal literals, which may fail on value precision rather than logic. Lines 231-233 of utils.py exceed 120 chars but predate this change. Nothing was committed.
